description: This commercial database maps on-farm grain storage across the United States, listing producers with grain bins, the number of bins, estimated bin sizes and bin locations as latitude and longitude. It also holds over 8,000 records of businesses around grain handling, classified by industry codes for agricultural chemical and fertiliser distribution, feed wholesalers, grain elevators, farm warehousing and elevator storage, and grain wholesalers. It is sold by US Farm Data, which operates the US Farm Vision site. Coverage is national. It is paid data available on request: the company walks buyers through the dataset and customises it by geography, crop region or operation type; no prices or licence terms are published. Caveats: bin sizes are estimates, the page read does not say how bins were detected or how often the data are refreshed, and the product is aimed at sales and marketing. For simulation it gives a rare picture of where grain is held before it reaches elevators, which helps model storage capacity and grain movement in food supply chains and the effect of rail, road or elevator outages after a disaster. It is related to the DesignSafe derecho grain bin reconnaissance record in this catalogue, which documents wind damage to bins.
